relation_types.label: Depends on
relation_types.forbidden_inference: A dependency grants no state or effect ownership.

relation_types.label: Writes to
relation_types.forbidden_inference: A write client cannot bypass store concurrency and authority checks.

relation_types.label: Reads from
relation_types.forbidden_inference: Read visibility does not grant advancement authority.

relation_types.label: Invokes
relation_types.forbidden_inference: Invocation transfers neither business ownership nor semantic authority.

relation_types.label: Publishes from
relation_types.forbidden_inference: Transport delivery cannot author committed state.

relation_types.label: Observes
relation_types.forbidden_inference: Observation cannot mutate or authorize its subject.

relation_types.label: Realizes Contract
relation_types.forbidden_inference: Contract realization does not prove a runtime guarantee beyond its evidence.

relation_types.label: Binds Realization
relation_types.forbidden_inference: A metadata binding is neither code nor runtime proof.

relations.contract: Create one immutable intent and frozen dispatch plan through the Recovery Coordination Repository and Unit of Work.
relations.forbidden_inference: The current in-process planner does not prove this durable write exists.

relations.contract: Persist the newly derived immutable intent and dispatch through the concern-specific Repository contract.
relations.forbidden_inference: The planner must not import a database or ORM adapter.

relations.contract: Create intent, dispatch, and dispatch-outbox records inside one local Recovery Unit of Work.
relations.forbidden_inference: This transaction cannot include recovery Operation business state.

relations.contract: Resolve every exact Operation binding before the first invocation.
relations.forbidden_inference: Binding resolution is not execution authority.

relations.contract: The durable worker uses the same all-or-nothing exact-binding preflight.
relations.forbidden_inference: A durable worker may not add fallback binding selection.

relations.contract: Advance dispatch, progress, authority-bound outcome, and outbox through the Recovery Repository and fenced local Unit of Work.
relations.forbidden_inference: Worker-local state is never the durable source of truth.

relations.contract: Read and advance coordination state only through the consumer-owned Repository contract.
relations.forbidden_inference: The worker must not import database or ORM mechanics.

relations.contract: Commit each coordination transition and dispatch-outbox record as one local change set.
relations.forbidden_inference: The local Unit of Work is not a transaction over the Workflow or recovery Operation.

relations.contract: The selected store adapter implements the exact Recovery Coordination Repository signatures.
relations.forbidden_inference: Implementation of the signatures alone proves no transaction or crash guarantee.

relations.contract: The selected store adapter implements the Recovery Unit of Work for the declared local participant set.
relations.forbidden_inference: The adapter cannot widen the participant set or atomicity scope.

relations.contract: Bind logical recovery persistence roles and the Repository contract to the selected store realization and evidence boundary.
relations.forbidden_inference: No DomainSpec Interface is required unless an actual logical boundary owns the persistence concern.

relations.contract: Name the exact adapter, resource, profile, logical-to-physical mapping, and bounded observations.
relations.forbidden_inference: The binding cannot select a database implicitly.

relations.contract: Bind the exact local atomicity scope, participant set, selected profile, and commit or rollback evidence.
relations.forbidden_inference: This is not Workflow-wide atomicity.

relations.contract: Every claimed transaction guarantee references typed retryable, non-retryable, and unknown failure outcomes.
relations.forbidden_inference: The failure classification cannot choose its continuation.

relations.contract: The durable profile explicitly composes its persistence realization rather than inheriting one from Workflow semantics.
relations.forbidden_inference: Synchronous Workflows do not inherit this runtime binding.

relations.contract: The durable profile explicitly composes its local transaction guarantees and evidence.
relations.forbidden_inference: Runtime composition does not create distributed atomicity.

relations.contract: Bind the comparable Clock used for Lease and Retry decisions.
relations.forbidden_inference: Clock implementation does not own committed time order or Claim authority.

relations.contract: Bind an optional queue, timer, or polling wakeup realization separately from durable truth.
relations.forbidden_inference: Wakeup delivery proves neither eligibility nor execution.

relations.contract: Acquire and prove the current fenced Claim before advancement.
relations.forbidden_inference: Claim authority grants no Operation business effect.

relations.contract: Prove the latest active Lease generation at each commit.
relations.forbidden_inference: A cached expiry value cannot authorize a commit.

relations.contract: Record one unique Attempt before invocation and one bounded outcome afterward.
relations.forbidden_inference: Claim or Lease activity alone cannot create an Attempt.

relations.contract: Present the stable Invocation Identity through the exact Operation binding and reuse the recorded result.
relations.forbidden_inference: The worker cannot claim semantic deduplication without Operation-owned durable evidence.

relations.contract: Delegate one authority-bound plan occurrence to the external execution contract.
relations.forbidden_inference: The existing executor is not itself a Claiming worker.

relations.contract: Persist an explicit retry continuation before releasing the occurrence for later eligibility.
relations.forbidden_inference: The worker cannot invent policy or retry indefinitely.

relations.contract: Request terminal recording only with the D44 evidence set.
relations.forbidden_inference: An attempt failure alone cannot terminate the recovery.

relations.contract: Acquire by dispatch-version compare-and-set and allocate a monotonic fencing token.
relations.forbidden_inference: Two independently written current claims are invalid even if different workers cannot see each other.

relations.contract: Commit Lease generations inside the coordination boundary.
relations.forbidden_inference: Renewal cannot change Claim identity or fencing token.

relations.contract: Lease activity remains subordinate to the current Claim.
relations.forbidden_inference: A Lease cannot revive a superseded Claim.

relations.contract: Evaluate bounded validity through the Recovery Clock contract.
relations.forbidden_inference: Clock selection may not redefine Claim or Lease semantics.

relations.contract: Persist selected policy, remaining budget, and not-before atomically with retry-scheduled state.
relations.forbidden_inference: An unpersisted timer is not a durable Retry.

relations.contract: Make retry eligible only when committed not-before is reached.
relations.forbidden_inference: Eligibility does not grant a Claim or create an Attempt.

relations.contract: Commit the evidence-bound terminal disposition and outbox with no successor.
relations.forbidden_inference: Terminal recording is not publication or successor selection.

relations.contract: Find expired authority and the first incomplete occurrence from committed state.
relations.forbidden_inference: A scan result cannot bypass fenced acquisition.

relations.contract: Takeover creates a new Claim and greater fencing token before resumed advancement.
relations.forbidden_inference: Restart cannot reuse expired authority.

relations.contract: Publish committed outbox records at least once without mutating dispatch truth.
relations.forbidden_inference: Message delivery order is not the dispatch version order unless explicitly observed.

relations.contract: Use polling, timers, or messages only as wakeup hints.
relations.forbidden_inference: A missing or duplicate wakeup cannot create or erase eligible durable work.

relations.contract: Observe committed state and publication lag through typed facts.
relations.forbidden_inference: Telemetry cannot repair or advance a dispatch.

relations.contract: Observe process episodes separately from semantic and durable coordination state.
relations.forbidden_inference: Worker health cannot determine semantic recovery status.
